# HRU -> MODFLOW cell map for domain_sagehen9, written by build_sagehen9.py
# columns: hru_index  cell_index((i-1)*ncol+j)  weight
#
# One land HRU per active cell, so this is the identity map and HRU area
# equals cell area exactly. The stream HRUs are deliberately absent: a reach's
# water column exchanges with the network, not with the cell beneath it, and
# co-mapping it would take an unowned share of that cell's recharge.
# hru_index is SUMMA's, which runs GRU by GRU; the attributes file is written
# in that order, so it is the row order of attributes.nc.
